title: Quintessential Earthy German Padron Peppers Tagine
description: A hearty, earthy German dish featuring padron peppers, perfect for a hangover cure, cooked to perfection in a clay tagine vessel using sous-vide techniques, gluten-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide water bath to 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the german sausage with caraway seeds, paprika, and salt.
Sear the sausage in a hot skillet until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the sliced onions to the same skillet and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the padron peppers to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, until they start to blister.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Transfer the skillet contents to the clay tagine vessel and add the browned sausage.
Cover the tagine and place it in the preheated sous-vide water bath for 2 hours.
Stir in the sour cream and chopped chives before serving.
